notes: The native UNTextInputNotificationResponse path remains unchanged through the production delegate and authenticated Chat transport.

The runtime persists an actor-bound reply before direct transport, reuses the same client_message_id for shared outbox replay and releases its lease on failure, cancellation, timeout or a later actor/session rejection.

Recovery reads the persistent store, retries once after any inherited crash lease expires and flushes only the current actor. Actor replacement cannot replay or delete the previous actor's reply or dismiss its routing notification.

While delivery is pending, iOS replaces the original banner with a local notification containing only conversation_id and recipient_profile_id. It never stores the typed reply in notification content and its default action follows the existing exact-chat deep link.

This closes the documented iOS offline, app-restart and post-reply exact-chat navigation limits. APNs, physical-device behavior, distribution and the complete negative remote trace remain outside this unit.
